run_passive: run the passive function to compute all passive forces for a mujoco model and data
compute_spring_damper_dof_passive: compute spring and damper passive forces for each degree of freedom joint
compute_spring_damper_tendon_passive: compute spring and damper passive forces for tendons and map to joint torques
compute_fluid_force: compute body-space fluid forces including added mass, drag, lift, and magnus effects
compute_gravity_force: compute gravity compensation forces for bodies with gravcomp coefficients
compute_flex_elasticity: compute elastic spring forces for flexible body elements using edge elongation
compute_flex_bending: compute bending forces for 2D flexible body elements using flap geometry
summarize_passive: summarize the passive module that computes spring, damper, gravity, fluid, and flex forces
